messages:
emma: heads up — CI flagged a bunch of anchor/link failures on PR #5123, blocking merge. linkcheck failure in /guides/migration/anchors.md
ci-bot: linkcheck: 4 broken anchors found (anchors.md: lines 32, 78 -> 404 target, 91 -> missing-heading)
sofia: thanks — I'll take the anchors. quick question: do we prefer adding redirects or fixing the anchor names in-place?
emma: prefer fixing anchors in-place unless that would break external links. keep the change tiny.
ryan: pushed a quick patch that renames the header to match the link target: `git commit -m "fix anchors in migration guide"`
maya: CI still failing — vale flagged passive voice in the same file: "is recommended" -> suggestion: "we recommend"
alex: vale nit. Should we silence this rule? it's stylistic not a content bug.
sofia: i'd rather edit to active voice. i'll push a follow-up. also spellcheck found `enviroment` -> `environment` and one other minor typo.
ci-bot: spellcheck: 1 typo fixed, 3 remaining across other files in the branch.
emma: plan: sofia fixes anchors + spell + small vale edits, ryan will re-run `yarn docs:preview` locally, then ping me. i'll merge in the next 30-min merge window if green.
ryan: ran preview locally — linkcheck passes now. pushing force-push with fixes.
sofia: pushed fixes and updated the migration guide changelog entry. PTAL @maya @emma
maya: reviewed, left one inline about phrasing in the intro. small nit only.
emma: LGTM. scheduling merge window at 15:00 UTC. if CI passes by then i'll merge. :calendar: 
ci-bot: preview-build: queued -> running
ci-bot: preview-build: failed — renderer flake on staging. Error: `Error: EADDRINUSE` during port bind (attempt to start preview server)
alex: looks like an infra flake, not docs. triggering rerun: `./scripts/ci retry-preview 5123`
ci-bot: preview-build: rerun started
ci-bot: preview-build: success
emma: merging now. thanks everyone :tada: 
sofia: thanks! i'll follow up with a tiny PR to update the SDK example that references the changed header.
ryan: noted, closing out.
